story.titleZh: 奥迪巴库带来14项气动升级，比诺托称符合预期
story.summaryZh: 奥迪在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前为巴库带来14类气动升级件，领队比诺托表示数据第一印象显示套件符合预期。一练仅博尔托莱托使用新套件，二练两车分列第14、15位。
story.originalTitle: 'The package is delivering as expected' – Audi reflect on new upgrade package after practice ahead of 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
story.summaryEn: Audi brought 14 aerodynamic upgrade components to Baku ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, with Team Principal Mattia Binotto saying the first impression from the data is that the package is delivering as expected. Only Gabriel Bortoleto ran the new package in FP1, and the two cars finished P14 and P15 in FP2.
detailZh: “套件正按预期交付”——奥迪在阿塞拜疆站练习后谈新升级套件。奥迪为争取本赛季进一步提升性能，在巴库带来了14个新部件。
奥迪领队马蒂亚·比诺托认为，车队在阿塞拜疆大奖赛前引入的重大升级套件“正按预期交付”。
这支欣维尔车队在FIA周末前提交的气动升级清单上勾选了14个类别，其中包括大幅改动的前翼和后翼、修订版地板以及新的引擎盖布局等。
作为相关性验证流程的一部分，一练中只有加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托使用了升级件，从而可以在巴库与尼科·霍肯伯格驾驶的旧规格赛车进行直接对比。
“如果看数据的第一印象，可以说，这套件正按预期交付，”比诺托说。
“这是好事，事实上这也是我们本周末的主要关注点。对我们来说，升级当然对性能很重要，对我们在锦标赛中的竞争也很重要。
“但同样，对我们来说，更重要的是确保车队在方法论和能力方面持续发展。
奥迪在巴库带来大量升级。“因此，从心态上的勇敢，到我们可能交付的气动概念类型，再到交期、工程、生产、制造，我们把挑战提上去了。
“就我们在这里带来的升级而言，最终能带来多少圈速提升并不重要。
“我认为对我们最重要的是，我们提高了挑战，再次在心态和交期等方面推动了整个系统，并希望我们能与风洞和模拟器保持正确的相关性。”
奥迪目前位列车队积分榜第八，仅落后哈斯4分，霍肯伯格和博尔托莱托在最近六场大奖赛中合计五次进入积分区。
博尔托莱托使用新套件在一练中位列第10，紧随其后的是霍肯伯格，随后两人在第二节练习中分列第14和第15。
“我觉得赛车在二练中感觉并不好，”博尔托莱托说。
“说实话，我们缺一点抓地力，还不明白原因。我对此没有答案。
“我猜这就是巴库，低附着、灰尘很大。赛道我想已经好几年没清理过了，我们只能这样开，然后尽力而为。”

detailEn: 'The package is delivering as expected' – Audi reflect on new upgrade package after practice in AzerbaijanAudi have brought 14 new components to Baku in a bid to gain further performance this season.
Audi Team Principal Mattia Binotto believes the team's major upgrade package, which has been introduced ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, is "delivering as expected".

The Hinwil outfit ticked 14 category boxes on the FIA’s pre-weekend submission list of aerodynamic upgrades, which includes substantially changed front and rear wings, a revised floor, and a new engine cover arrangement amongst others.
As part of the correlation process, only Gabriel Bortoleto had the updates in FP1, allowing for a direct comparison with Nico Hulkenberg’s older spec car in Baku.
“If you look at the first, let me say, impression of the data, the package is delivering as expected,” said Binotto.
“Which is good, which is our main focus, as a matter of fact, for the weekend. For us, upgrading, yes, it’s important for the performance, it’s important for our fight in the championship.
“But again, for us, what’s more important is to make sure that the team is developing in terms of methodologies and capacity.

Audi have a big raft of upgrades in Baku"So from being brave when it comes to mindset, to the type of aero concepts we may deliver, on the lead times, engineering, production, manufacturing, we raised the challenge.
"With the upgrade we have brought here, it doesn’t matter how much it will deliver in terms of lap time.

"I think what matters for us the most is having raised the challenge, having again pushed the system on whatever is mindset and lead times, and hopefully we’ll have a correlation which is right compared to the wind tunnel and the sim.”
Audi sit eighth in the teams' standings, just four points behind Haas, with Hulkenberg and Bortoleto having finished in the points at five of the last six Grands Prix between them.
Bortoleto was able to finish P10 in FP1 with the new package, just ahead of Hulkenberg, before the pair finished P14 and P15 in the second session.
“I think the car didn't feel amazing in FP2,” said Bortoleto.
“If I'm very honest, we're lacking a little bit of grip, still to understand why. I don't have answers for that.
“I guess that's Baku, low grip, super dusty. The track has not been cleaned, I think, for a few years now, and yeah, just we need to drive with this and then try our best.”

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
